Reference / regex/match

regex/match#

RegexMatching is the observable surface shared by mandatory search results and matches yielded by RegexMatches.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let found = FirstRegexMatch("id=42", Regex("id=(?<id>\\d+)"));
found.text();             // "id=42"
found.capture(0).text();  // "id=42", the complete match
found.group("id").text(); // "42"
found.captures().size();  // 1; capture zero is not duplicated

Description#

RegexMatching is the observable surface shared by mandatory search results and matches yielded by RegexMatches. Implementations are immutable:

An optional group still has a RegexCapture. matched() is false when that group did not participate; text() and range() then throw UnmatchedRegexCapture instead of inventing empty text or a fake range.

Named groups also read like json values (#217):

let date = FirstRegexMatch("due 2026-11", Regex("(?<year>\\d{4})-(?<month>\\d{2})(-(?<day>\\d{2}))?"));
date.int("year");                     // 2026
date.text("month");                   // "11"
date.maybe("day").text() else "";     // "": the group took no part

object RegexMatch#

object RegexMatch does RegexMatching

The constructor requires an opaque RegexMatchState. Application code cannot manufacture that state; regex/search is its only public producer.

RegexMatch.text#

text(name is string) is string

The text of a named group: found.text("month"). A name the pattern does not have is MissingRegexGroup; a group that took no part in the match is UnmatchedRegexCapture.

RegexMatch.int#

int(name is string) is int

A named group as an integer: found.int("year"). Text that is not one is InvalidRegexGroupValue, naming the group and the text.

RegexMatch.maybe#

maybe(name is string) is RegexMaybeValue

A named group that may have taken no part in the match: found.maybe("day").text() else "".

object RegexMaybeValue#

object RegexMaybeValue

A group that may have taken no part in a match: its readers answer Maybe. Text that is there but is not what the reader expects is still InvalidRegexGroupValue.
